tools.name: compile_floor_plan
tools.description: Compile ArchLang DSL source into a floor plan for a ZoneWise parcel. Returns SVG markup, compiler diagnostics (errors/warnings), and a structured summary of rooms, doors, windows, and areas (m²). If `parcel` is provided, also runs zoning compliance against that parcel's actual buildable-envelope constraints and returns it as `zoning`.

tools.name: check_zoning_compliance
tools.description: Check a compiled plan's building footprint against a specific parcel's buildable-envelope constraints. Dimensional-fit and coverage check only, not a full site-plan setback check.

tools.name: validate_floor_plan
tools.description: Compiler diagnostics only, no SVG rendering.

tools.name: get_room_schedule
tools.description: Structured room/door/window schedule. Areas natively m²; convert to sqft client-side (m² * 10.7639).

notes.pdf_dxf_png: SVG only in the Worker. PDF (pdfkit) confirmed non-functional in Workers. PNG (@resvg/resvg-js) cannot run in Workers at all.
notes.zoning_constraints: Implemented — see zoning.js. Dimensional fit + lot coverage % + septic bedroom cap only. Does NOT check height or real site placement.
